title: Log triage: top offenders
hints: Decide the format per line: strip it, an empty line is junk, a line starting with { goes to json.loads inside try/except ValueError, everything else goes to one anchored regex with named groups.
The syslog regex needs an optional pid: (?P<process>[^\s\[:]+)(?:\[\d+\])?: then \s*(?P<message>.*)$. Check isinstance(obj, dict) and that host and message are strings before trusting JSON.
count_offenders is a Counter keyed by the tuple (host, error_class); skip records where classify returns None.
Do not use Counter.most_common for ties. Build (host, class, count) tuples and sort with key=lambda r: (-r[2], r[0], r[1]), then slice [:n].
